upstream_sync.relationship: routes installed specialist skills; does not copy their implementation

intent.description:
Route target trial emulation (TTE) work through the installed TTE_CC toolkit. Use when a user wants to
formulate, sharpen, audit/审核, analyze, check, or report an observational target trial, or select a
cardiovascular research question from literature before TTE design, especially for
cardiovascular, heart failure, ICU, MIMIC/eICU, INSPIRE, or MOVER studies. Select the smallest useful
set of the eight TTE_CC skills, preserve the target-trial protocol before estimation, and use the
project's clinical and data-semantic rules, including confounding/混杂 and positivity/共同支持. This skill routes work; it does not replace the specialist
skills or turn teaching examples into executed clinical analyses.
intent.job_to_be_done: Turn a clinical research question into an evidence-aware estimand, data-support gate, and minimal target-trial-emulation specialist route.

should_trigger: 使用 TTE 路由 Skill，先把心衰问题写成目标试验协议。
审核这个研究的 time zero、持续利尿策略和竞争事件。
协议已经冻结，请选择 tte-estimate、check-emulation 和 tte-report。
MIMIC 和 eICU 的目标试验模拟应该怎样路由到 TTE_CC？
用目标试验方法评估心衰利尿治疗的混杂和共同支持。
使用 TTE 路由，先查阅心衰肾功能恶化后的利尿策略文献，找研究空白并生成候选 estimand。
使用 TTE 路由，同一个人在多个入组时点可能属于不同策略，请判断 sequential trial 和 cloning 如何路由。
使用 TTE，协议已冻结，请选择竞争风险和 per-protocol effect 的统计方法。
should_not_trigger: 帮我创建一个交通仿真 Skill。
普通地整理一个 Markdown 文档目录。
只做一个普通的因果推断概念解释，不涉及临床研究或 TTE。
near_neighbor: 只做一个没有因果问题的普通 ICU 描述性统计。
帮我查当前目标期刊的影响因子。

permissions.network: only when the user requests literature or source verification
permissions.file_write: the project skill package and explicitly requested protocol/report files
permissions.subprocess: local validation and explicitly requested analysis commands
permissions.interactive: ask only for a decision that changes the estimand or irreversible action

scaffold: README hook and natural trigger examples

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
